review: A Poise ID with some bleed application on top. To start she wants to crit as much as possible yet barely has any poise potency gain which makes her very inconsistent. But in a Blade Lineage team, she can pop off very easily with the amount of poise gain support, making her S tier with it. Now onto her plum mechanics, it is a debuff that increases the chance to receive critical damage and enhances the damage while also inflicting bleed potency although this last part only works on critting. Plum count is reduced regardless if the attack was a crit or not. In a bleed team, the only IDs that can effectively make use of it are pirate Gregor, KK Rodion, and Faust herself. In a Blade Lineage team, the extra crit chance and damage are nice but you would barely have any count to keep up the bleed potency Moving on to her coin rolls, she can roll 9/16/17 but gets extra power based on poise potenc
